statements.text: Classic inverse head and shoulder pattern

drawn_objects: hand-drawn black inverse head-and-shoulders: left shoulder low (~early Jun), deeper head low (~late Jun/early Jul), right shoulder low, then an up-arrow breaking up through the neckline at the right edge
long position tool over the May rally: teal profit box above a pink stop box (entry/target/stop labels not shown)
grey supply/demand zone near the top of the chart with a black dashed midline
wide grey zone across the ~75k area
grey zone across the ~69-71k area (where price broke down)
grey zone at the bottom around the 44,000-48,000 region with a black dashed midline
four solid green horizontal lines (one truncated at ~mid-Jun, three full-width)
four blue/cyan dashed horizontal lines, the lowest sitting just under the current price
purple lightning-bolt icon on the time axis (TradingView event marker)
chart.visible_date_range: axis labelled May, Jun, Jul, Aug 2026; candle data runs from ~late Apr/May 2026 to 14 Jul 2026, with empty projection space out to Aug
chart.what_the_drawing_says: BTC topped near 74.5k in May, broke down through the ~69-71k grey zone and has been basing between roughly 59.5k and 62.7k; Ace has traced a hand-drawn inverse head-and-shoulders across that base with the neckline at ~62.1-62.7k and an arrow breaking out upward, i.e. he expects the base to resolve higher back toward the stacked levels at 65k-75k. A separate untested demand zone sits far below at ~44-48k.

claims: Classic inverse head and shoulder pattern
notes: Same 14/07/2026 04:19 chart as IMG_7862 but scrolled so the full chart, time axis and the follow-up text are visible; the extra axis tags 59,549.6 and 59,515.7 (both red) are readable here. 56,000.0 / 52,000.0 / 48,000.0 / 44,000.0 are ordinary grey axis gridline labels, NOT drawn levels, so they are excluded from drawn_levels. One grey tag above 89,027.3 remains cut off ('89,2??.?') and is not recorded; a stray '0' glyph sits to its right. 'Classic inverse head and shoulder pattern' and 'Live call soon everyone @everyone' appear below the chart's reaction row as grouped follow-up messages with no visible timestamp header — author is Ace, time is after 2026-07-14 04:19 but not readable, so timestamps are null. Only the second line carries the yellow @everyone mention highlight, which is why the two lines are recorded as separate messages rather than one block. Reaction count on the chart message: ❤️ 4. 'Everything as planned' is listed in both claims and boasts: it is a retrospective, unfalsifiable self-validation with no numbers attached. The '20 July 2026' day divider at the bottom is partially occluded by the '#ticket-0514' banner.
